headline: MCA STUDENT | DATA ANALYSIS | SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT
summary: Detail-oriented MCA student with a strong foundation in SQL, Python, structured data management, and quantitative problem solving. Experienced in developing data-driven systems involving database management, analytical dashboards, and structured data reporting. Possesses strong analytical and data interpretation capabilities with a deep interest in financial markets, quantitative analysis, and supporting data-informed decision making.

projects.name: SkillSphere
projects.subtitle: Intelligent Career Readiness & Placement Ecosystem
bullets: Developed an AI-powered career readiness platform incorporating assessment data, skill tracking, and placement analytics to support quantitative evaluation.
Implemented standardized career assessments and progress tracking to organize readiness metrics and drive data-backed student recommendations.
Engineered role-based dashboards with Recharts to deliver clear visual reporting and presentation of structured placement analytics.
Integrated MongoDB Atlas for scalable database management, ensuring reliable storage, retrieval, and analysis of multi-dimensional performance data.

projects.name: CodeX Arena
projects.subtitle: Real-Time Competitive Coding Battle Platform
bullets: Developed a real-time competitive coding platform managing dynamic user activity, competition metrics, and evaluation data.
Built REST APIs using FastAPI and MongoDB Atlas to manage, query, and structure submission datasets and user performance records.
Integrated Judge0 API for multi-language code execution, automated test evaluation, and structured result reporting.
Implemented WebSockets for live event synchronization and JWT authentication to secure platform data access and user transactions.

projects.name: Fuel Agency Management System
bullets: Developed a full-stack booking and agency management system managing operational records across customer, supplier, cylinder inventory, and booking modules.
Integrated MySQL with Hibernate to design relational data schemas, perform SQL database management, and maintain transactional data integrity.
Implemented role-based authentication and authorization for Admin and Customer accounts to safeguard commercial booking data.
Created automated email notification services to support operational communication and streamline transaction-related workflows.
